title: Touching the reactor's repulsive field

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in Nevada where he says the US studied craft not made by humans, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about the power source, or reactor, he says he saw there. He says it made a gravity-like field around itself that you could physically push on and feel pushing back. If true, it would mean someone held technology that controls gravity.
